free_tier.stated: No free tier. The plan is USD 12.00 a year for 1 GB, which is exactly USD 1.00 a month.

retention.stated: The VPS persists while the annual term is paid. No deletion schedule was readable; the vendor site answered with a security-verification page.

egress.terms: 1 TB a month, per the offer as published.

interface_detail: KVM guest in Frankfurt with IPv4 and a /64 IPv6, per the offer text.
tooling: Any SSH client; KVM per the offer text.
chaining: A 1 GB KVM guest with both IPv4 and a /64 for USD 12.00 a year: the shape wants, but the price sits exactly on the line rather than under it.
binding_note: 1 TB a month is the first hard number, and the whole offer is thin enough that the vendor's willingness to keep selling at USD 12 is the real limit.

identity_cost.detail: Self-service order with an email account, per the offer text. No card hold and no payment-method list could be read, because the vendor site served a 'Security Verification' page instead of the shop.

reliability_note: The vendor site returns a bot-verification page to every reader tried today; the price and shape come from a January 2026 LowEndBox post and a September 2026 community listing, not from the vendor.
confidence_note: The vendor page could not be read: a text read failed and a raw byte fetch returned a 'Security Verification' page. The numbers are from LowEndBox's post and FilterVPS's listing, both second-hand.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'You can get a VPS for only $1-a-month (billed $12/year) with 1GB VPS, 1TB of transfer, IPv4 + /64 IPv6!'

quoted: 'Servitro's $1 Server is a budget VPS deal hosted in Germany at $12.00 per year ($1.00 per month), with 1 vCPU, 1 GB of the RAM and 10 GB of storage on KVM virtualization ... Last verified: 2026-09-12'

extras.price_arithmetic: USD 12.00 a year / 12 = USD 1.00 a month exactly. Out of pocket at order: USD 12.00.
